title: My Stepdaughter Forged My Signature, Stole $260K, Gave Me $10K. So I Bought Her Yoga Studio.
description: After my stepdaughter forged my signature to steal my share of her $950K salon sale and gave me a $10,000 'thank you,' I sued for fraud. The court awarded me $260,000, and when she couldn't pay, I bought her yoga studio at auction and made her teach a free weekly class called Flexing the Truth. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #YogaAndLipstick
thumb_text: I BOUGHT HER YOGA STUDIO AND MADE HER TEACH
pinned_comment: If your stepdaughter took $88,000 to start her dream salon, then forged your signature and paid you a $10,000 'thank you' after selling it for $950K, would you have bought her yoga studio and made her teach a free class like I did? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I HAD A CONTRACT FOR 30% OF HER PROFITS
